regions.finding: The abstract states the two product classes, while the introduction discusses generic electrophilic cyclization and cited prior work; these broad claims and citations were not duplicated as batch experiments.

regions.region: lower-left opening experiment and upper-right continuation
regions.finding: The prose gives Table 1 entries 1–5 explicitly and summarizes entries 6–9. These statements were merged as corroborating evidence into the nine independent Table 1 rows rather than creating duplicate experiments.

The narrative summarizes all eleven Table 2 rows, including 60 °C for 1c, 4.0 equiv iodine for 1f/1g, the 3h–j product class, and the 88% aqueous-MeCN result for 1j. It was linked to the row-level records on page 2.

The statement that normal 1,2-allenyl ketones did not work lacks a mapped substrate, row, conditions, and outcome value, so it was retained as unresolved context rather than fabricated as a complete failure experiment.

unresolved: The main text does not provide a row-level identity or conditions for the stated failure of non-perfluoroalkyl 1,2-allenyl ketones.
Operational details absent from the supplied main-text pages were not inferred from the statement that supplementary data exist.

regions.finding: A proposed electrophilic-addition intermediate branches to furan 2 when R2 = H or water-trapped dihydrofuranol 3 otherwise, followed by generic coupling arrows. It is stored once as a mechanism/general route, without experimental yields.
The depicted fluorine-containing furan compounds are biological examples supporting the introduction, not reactions reported in this paper; no experiment records were created from the figure.

Nine independent optimization rows were extracted with solvent, water equivalents, temperature, time, NMR yield, and recovered 1a. Entries 2 and 3 retain the unidentified inseparable byproduct note; entry 4 retains both 99% and the undefined parenthesized 93% value.

Eleven independent substrate-scope rows were extracted. Footnote overrides were applied per row: 60 °C and 98% purity for entry 3, 4.0 equiv iodine for entries 6–7, 29% recovery for entry 10, and MeCN/H2O = 20/1 for entry 11.

regions.region: bottom acknowledgments and Supplementary data notice
regions.finding: The paper states that supplementary data exist online and identifies reproduced Table 2 entries, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated; no SI-derived conditions were imported.

unresolved: Table 2 does not state whether the reported yields are isolated, NMR, or another basis.
Table 1 does not define the basis of the parenthesized 93% value in entry 4.
Most row-level operational details, exact scale, atmosphere, workup, and purification are absent from the supplied main-text pages.
Candidate substrate/product structures require independent chemical review.

regions.region: entire printed content: References and notes 1–10
regions.finding: The page contains only citations and bibliographic notes. These are prior literature or reviews, not new experiments of the present paper, so no records were created from page 3.
